what_changed: the surplus evaluator's policy-to-pool mapping, and nothing else: the same checkpoints, the same split, the same tensor, the same solver artifact and the same aggregation were re-scored

v1.mapping: p_theta(i) = softmax(log pi_theta(i)) over the pool
v1.defect: only equals the finite-pool induced distribution when p_t is the conditional LM mass over the pool. Here p_t is UNIFORM (every row of pi_t.npz is 0.125), so v1 scored absolute log-probabilities, which track response length and content rather than what training changed. It also fails the identity check: at theta = theta_t it does not return p_t.

v2.mapping: p_theta(i) proportional to p_t(i) * exp(log pi_theta(i) - log pi_t(i))
v2.note: the script refuses to report if either unit check fails

held_fixed_across_v1_and_v2.split: the same 150/150 validation/test prompt map, salt nbpo-smoke-valtest
held_fixed_across_v1_and_v2.checkpoints: identical; no arm was retrained between v1 and v2

explicitly_not_the_reason: no arm improved. The checkpoints are byte-identical to the ones v1 scored; only the evaluator changed.
